scope: SM2 Spider-Man costumes only; retail environments, NPCs, and enemies are unchanged

capturePolicy.fmvRejection: Every new frame must carry a unique process run token, a native live-3D 16bpp marker, and four exact actor-free main-menu chrome matches
capturePolicy.introSkip: Process-local START pulses stop at the title.bmr boundary; no host input
capturePolicy.processPolicy: a game-level named mutex permits only one OpenSpidey game process

reviewPolicy: All 95 fresh schema-3 frames were inspected individually in slot and frame order after the exclusive-process, boot-boundary, native-3D, and exact-menu gates passed.
evidencePolicy: Each costume entry points to its evidence directory; the locked runtimeReport captureSequence is the authoritative list of five individually reviewed frames. Contact sheets are summaries only.

textureProvenance.policy: Use the Dreamcast Spider-Man mesh with each selected PS1 SM2 sp_texNN.psx library byte-for-byte; slots 13 and 17 stage their dedicated Dreamcast topology actors.

costumes.adaptation: Dedicated Dreamcast Bag-Man geometry and textures on the complete SM2 skeleton; interactive selection swaps the complete processed actor binding rather than relying on a test-time spidey.psx alias; no fabricated generic wings; topology-guarded nested-shell depth ordering; compact VRAM pages plus original-resolution host replacements.

costumes.finding: The cyan torso and broad white eye/visor treatment match the untouched retail PS1 actor across the complete five-frame pose sequence; sp_tex14.psx is byte-exact retail data.

costumes.adaptation: Dedicated Dreamcast Peter Parker geometry and textures on the complete SM2 skeleton; interactive selection swaps the complete processed actor binding rather than relying on a test-time spidey.psx alias; no fabricated generic wings; compact VRAM pages plus original-resolution host replacements.

costumes.finding: The pale chest, thigh, shin, and exposed lower-face regions match the untouched retail PS1 SM2 actor; sp_tex18.psx is byte-exact retail data rather than a UV-transfer artifact.
